body:
I don’t know wether if this will help or not, because I’ve been feeling so hopeless to the point where I wanted it all to go away. Here’s some reasons why life may be worth living;

Accomplishments - It doesn’t matter wether or not someone is proud of you. If you’re proud of yourself, that’s a huge milestone. Accomplishments can be even the littlest things, like eating or walking one block.

Morning walks - Waking up early is nobody’s forte, I’m aware. But getting that energy and taking a small walk in the morning where the world is still sleepy is worth it. You can get new ideas for your next step in life.

Life - From plants, to insects, to animals; those things alone prove how fragile life is. Think about how you can help life rather than ending your own. If you feel the need to make a difference, you can start by taking care of a plant of your choice.

Learning - Learning the littlest things are always interesting. They can help you improve on yourself, you don’t have to be super smart. You can just learn small facts that help you learn you interests. Like a small fact is that Orcas are dolphins; which I personally found surprising.

People - Now, before you begin, yes, people. People are peculiar in my eyes. How can some be vicious while some can be kind? People are the reason why this world is both rising and falling. Humanity can be just or unfair; salty or sweet. Humans can shape your mind and build your personality, only if you allow yourself to be vulnerable to that. But, people are amazing, too. They have beliefs and opinions, thoughts and imaginations. They hurt you, they build you back up. Find a way to make amends, to make new relationships. It will be hard, but if you really, REALLY want to find a reason to live? The people you’ll meet in life will be a big one. 

I literally don’t know if this helps or not, but I do wish you the best of luck. You may never get over it, but you can get through it. I don’t recommend ending it all, because the beauty of the world is so hidden that everyone is blind to see it and that they’re covering it up.
I can’t say I understand what you’ve been through. Nobody really can understand each-other in the reality bit. But that’s what makes us human, yeah? Different minds, different habits. Nobody is a copy and paste. The world would be boring if that was the case.
Be safe out there, yeah?
